resources.string: Types your keyboard layout: the keys you changed in Titan2 Keys type what you set them to. Double-tap Shift, Alt or Sym to lock it, with a badge at the top of the screen. Press Sym and Shift together to turn a Super (Windows) key on and off, for example for Moonlight. Sym+C turns a controller layer on and off, where the keys you bind act as gamepad buttons. Keys your layout, a lock, Super or the controller changes are sent to the app through the Titan2 Emoji keyboard; all other keys go through untouched. No keystrokes are logged or stored.
